name: regulon_recovery
motivation: The binary causal-grounding RATE does not beat a label-shuffle null on Norman CRISPRa (LAB_NOTEBOOK 2026-08-10): K562 variance is dominated by ~2 axes (erythroid, stress), so the data-driven matcher grounds ~any labeling. This metric selects each TF's feature from EXTERNAL ground truth (TRRUST regulons), removing that failure mode, then asks one causal question per TF.

ground_truth.source: TRRUST v2 human curated TF->target edges

dataset: Norman 2019 CRISPRa (K562), single-gene overexpressions, prepped by src/prep_norman.py (raw counts, gene-symbol var_names, control label 'control').

test.step1_feature_selection: For each TF with >= MIN_TARGETS TRRUST targets present in the panel, select the SAE feature whose top-TOP_K gene-association genes (Pearson feature-vs-gene over CONTROL cells) are most enriched for the TF's targets (min hypergeometric p, Bonferroni-corrected over all features). Label-free; invariant under the shuffle.
test.step2_causal_activation: Mann-Whitney one-sided greater: is the selected feature's activation higher in TF-OE cells than control cells? AUC = P(act_OE > act_ctrl).
test.recovers_iff: enrichment BH-q < ALPHA (over tested TFs) AND activation BH-q < ALPHA (over tested TFs) AND AUC >= AUC_FLOOR.

headline: n_recovered (real) vs its LABEL-SHUFFLE null (permute OE labels among non-control cells; feature selection fixed, only the causal activation re-tested). empirical_p = (1 + #{null >= real}) / (1 + n_shuffle). POSITIVE result = n_recovered above the null (empirical_p < 0.05).
seeds: run seeds 0,1,2; a TF counts as robustly recovered if it recovers in >= 2/3 seeds.

interpretation_rules.low_power_not_negative: TFs with < MIN_TARGETS panel targets (e.g. KLF1 has 2 TRRUST targets) are reported low_power and EXCLUDED from the tested pool; they are not counted as negatives.
interpretation_rules.negative_is_real: A non-significant headline is a genuine negative, NOT a blind-method artifact: feature selection uses external truth, so it is not structurally blind (unlike the V0b per-feature test).
interpretation_rules.no_freezing_inconclusive: Do not SHA-freeze any recovered-TF table from an inconclusive or failed run; freeze only this SPEC (design), never results out of a broken run.

code: src/regulon_recovery.py (analysis core pure numpy/scipy); tests/test_regulon_recovery.py (synthetic oracle: recovers exactly the causal TFs, rejects regulon-but-not-activated and no-regulon TFs, shuffle null collapses, low-power flagged).
run: python3 src/regulon_recovery.py --adata norman_pert.h5ad --pert-col perturbation --control-value control --latent 2048 --k 32 --n-hvg 4000 --n-shuffle 50 --seed {0,1,2} --out causal_out/regulon_recovery_seed{S}.json
